evaluatedLibrary.name: libxml2-wasm
evaluatedLibrary.reason: Its published WASM binary omits native APIs consumed by LibreOffice unoxml, including xmlCopyNode and xmlNewDocProp. Reuse its Emscripten module build approach with pinned upstream C instead of emulating libxml2 DOM behavior in JavaScript.

cppBindings.note: Same no-pthread realm-local profile; actual C++ constructor/destructor/lock/unlock, no JS lock registry. Native threads/OOM/system_error and invalid lifetime remain unqualified.

localeBindings.library: Pinned Emscripten SDK musl libc locale/environment and pthread ABI
localeBindings.note: Actual newlocale(LC_CTYPE_MASK), nl_langinfo_l(CODESET), source64-byte copy/freelocale and static PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER. No host environment/locale provider or host filesystem mount. Current non-pthread profile only.

fileBindings.note: Original selected Emscripten file-open OSL flag/mode mapping and actual open/fcntl whole-file write lock, realpath/errno/abort; no host filesystem mount. Path allowlist decisions remain in source-owned sal/osl/unx/file.access.ts and run before native open. Source file URL wrappers publish actual native EOVERFLOW through office_file_set_overflow.

securityBindings.profile: Original __EMSCRIPTEN__ current-security fallback and byte home lookup only. No logon, credentials, host mount, external DNS or network. The actual SDK effective UID getter is exposed for the original UNIX QA branch; it does not read the host user identity.

localHostnameBindings.source: sal/osl/unx/socket.cxx local hostname and its original host-address helpers
localHostnameBindings.note: User-approved local hostname/FQDN authority dependency only. Actual pinned libc gethostname and getaddrinfo/freeaddrinfo over the existing SDK synthetic DNS table; no socket creation, connection, external DNS or host network lookup.

fileStatBindings.note: Actual pinned SDK libc access/lstat and selected header layout/dirent type mapping. Native mode/size/time/inode fields are copied losslessly into source-owned JS records; no alternate stat provider, host mounts or filesystem access.

fileCopyBinding.note: Actual selected libc stat/rename/unlink/readlink/symlink/write/close plus exact O_WRONLY|O_CREAT destination flags. Only genuine SDK FS ErrnoError is published to native errno by the JS OSL owner. No host mount or replacement filesystem; public copy uses preserveMetadata=false.

tempFilePrerequisites.note: Actual libc mkdir/rmdir/getpid and original native function-static OSL mutex owner/pointer-to-handle field. SDK environment and MEMFS only; no host mount/environment/process identity access. Global field storage/destructor remain native. Static facade borrows the actual pointer, no second owner.
